answer: Sponsors are capped at 7 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 51 POA until the newcomer survives 15 clean epochs, and a farm of 380 fakes must find 380 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. What carries the vertex here is verification, the jetty of cost is what stops the farm, and the raven of the record keeps every claim checkable.
